name: 活動日時を添えたチャンネル選択
prompt:
Recreate the single Japanese Discord channel-selection row shown in the primary native preview. Match its very wide, short 390x70 canvas proportion exactly as closely as possible. Keep the whole row visible edge to edge with minimal white canvas margin above and below. This is a faithful reconstruction, not a redesign.

On the plain white background, place a small light-gray outline # channel glyph near x24 y17. To its right, place the exact bold dark Japanese channel label 「地域からのお知らせ」 starting near x64 y13, about 14px in the logical canvas. Place the smaller muted-gray activity line 「5日前に活動」 starting near x24 y44, about 12px. Keep the unusual native alignment of the activity line beginning beneath the left icon. On the far right, place one compact forest-green rounded square selected checkbox around x340 y18, 24x24px, with a small white check.

Keep a single sparse row with no panel background, divider, shadow or extra controls. Do not add other channel names, emoji, speaker glyphs, badges or explanatory copy. The Japanese native row has no hyperlink text; the channel name is a selectable channel label, not a hyperlink, so keep it dark. If an actual hyperlink label is visible, render the linked words blue. Do not recolor the green selected checkbox blue.

Use the native preview as the authority for all Japanese text, logical positions, colors and selected state. The full source screen is context only; exclude app header, onboarding card, search, channel categories, other rows and footer.
reviewNotes: v001を実画像で目視。地域からのお知らせ、5日前に活動、灰色の#と森林緑の選択チェックを保持。リンク文言なし。出力2171x724はnative390x70（比率5.57）に対して比率3.00で、上下の白余白が過大。右のチェックもnativeより内側。第2版では短い横長帯として余白を減らし、チェックを右端のnative位置へ動かす。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
